name: Souvenir passport
summary: A passport spread with an ink stamp for each stop of the poster's trip; friends hang a souvenir request off a stamp (magnet, snacks, hot sauce, a shirt) with their words, and the traveller ticks them off as they pack.
useWhen: day 4 of the trip lowkey never coming back
having fun in south america eating tostadas, bringing stuff back
trip update quito then banos then cuenca
dontUseWhen: planning a trip that hasn't started (use trip-draft)
a recap after the trip is over (use trip-story)

trip.description: The trip's name, shown as the title

line.description: The post's own line, shown in quotes

stops.description: Stops so far in order with a short date; the last three are stamped

asks.description: Souvenir requests already hanging: who, the stop's city, the item, their words, and whether it is packed
